about: Three extra characters for tools/ts2kitbash.py, built from the disc's files and added to the roster in spare slots, so every character on the disc stays. Their files take over chr71-chr73, NeoTokyo pedestrians (chr ids 70-72) carried by no arcade pak.

characters.name: Agent Static
characters.head: chr133
characters.about: Jake Fenton's suit, R-109's head; the vest electric teal, the shirt cool grey
characters.bio: A signal nobody sent. Agent Static turns up wherever the timestream crackles, and has never once been asked for identification.

characters.name: The Bone Ranger
characters.head: chr64
characters.about: Elijah Jones's duster, X-Ray Skel's skull; the coat near-black
characters.bio: Shot, hanged and buried in the same afternoon, he took it as a personal insult. The Bone Ranger still collects every bounty on the frontier, he just has nowhere to spend it.

characters.name: Monkey Business
characters.head: chr03
characters.about: Mr Underwood's tweed suit, Monkey's head; the tweed purple
characters.bio: Mr Underwood's finest tweed, now with a monkey in it. Monkey Business takes the meetings, signs nothing and has already eaten the contract.
